name: 托福词汇
description: 托福考试词汇（来源：english-wordlists/TOEFL.txt），按 COCA 词频排序

words.meaning: a.  平坦的,偶数的,相等的,均匀的,连贯的,均等的,公平的,荹玫?平静的,
words.example: Everyone I know likes the smell of bacon - even Mike does and he's a vegetarian.  我认识的所有人都喜欢培根的味道——即使麦克也不例外，他可是个素食主义者呀。

words.meaning: n.  蒸馏室,寂静,剧照vt.  vi.  蒸馏,(使)平静,(使)静止a.  静止的,不
words.example: I'm still hungry.  我还是很饿。

words.meaning: n.  情况; 国家; 州; v.  陈述
words.example: The building was in a state of disrepair.  这栋大楼年久失修。

words.meaning: a.  低劣的,卑贱的,卑鄙的,麻烦的,简陋的,吝啬的,惭愧的,中间的vt.  意
words.example: What does this word mean?  这个词是甚么意思？

words.meaning: n.  公司,友伴,交际,一群,朋友,连队vt.  陪伴vi.  交往
words.example: He works for a software company/a company that makes software.  他在一家软体公司工作。

words.meaning: n.  发行,问题,后果,争端,出口vi.  发行,流出,传下,进行辩护,造成. . .
words.example: As employers we need to be seen to be addressing (= dealing with) these issues sympathetically.  作为雇主，我们需要让大家知道我们在处理这些问题时富有同情心。

words.meaning: n.  头,头脑,最前的部分,脑袋,领袖vt.  为首,朝向,前进,用头顶vi.  成
words.example: Put this hat on to keep your head warm.  戴上这顶帽子，给头部保暖。

words.meaning: a.  长的,长久的,冗长的,做多头的vi.  渴望,热望,极想ad.  长久,始终n.
words.example: I've been waiting a long time.  我已经等了很久了。

words.meaning: vt.  提供,供应,预备,装备vi. 作准备,瞻养,规定
words.example: This booklet provides useful information about local services.  这本小册子提供了有关当地服务机构的有用资讯。

words.meaning: n.  站立,站住,停顿,讲台,法院证人席,立场vi.  站,立,坐落,停滞,维持原
words.example: Granny says if she stands (up) for a long time her ankles hurt.  奶奶说她站久了脚踝会痛。

words.meaning: n.  社区,公众,共有,共同体
words.example: He's well-known in the local community.  他在当地非常闻名。

words.meaning: n.  总统，(大学)校长，总经理
words.example: [as form of address] Thank you, Mr/Madam President.  谢谢您，总统阁下。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  分,分钟,笔记,备忘录,片刻vt.  记录,摘录,测定时间a.  微小的,详细
words.example: It takes me twenty minutes to get to work.  我上班路上要花20分钟。

words.meaning: n.  铅,铅条,领导,提示,领引,导线,主角,榜样vt.  引导,带领,领导,指挥,
words.example: I've asked Gemma to lead the discussion.  我已请杰玛带领大家讨论。

words.meaning: n.  手表,看守,值班人,监视vt.  看,注视,照顾,监视,守护,看守vi.  观看
words.example: He spent the entire afternoon watching a cricket match.  他整个下午都在看一场板球比赛。

words.meaning: n.  水平(高度); 级别; a.  水平的; v.  夷平，使平坦
words.example: The water level in the lake is much higher after heavy rain.  暴雨过后这个湖的水位上升了很多。

words.meaning: n.  宴会,党,政党,社交聚会,当事人vt. vi.  举行社交聚会
words.example: Peter has/gives/throws really wild parties.  彼得举办的聚会很疯狂。

words.meaning: n.  理由,原因,理智,理性,前提,道理vt.  说服,推论,辩论vi.  推论,劝说
words.example: The reason for the disaster was engine failure, not human error.  这次灾难的原因是引擎故障，而非人为错误。

words.meaning: n.  出价,提议,意图,报价vt.  提供,出价,奉献,演出,使出现,企图vi.  出
words.example: She was offered a job in Paris.  她在巴黎得到了一份工作。

words.meaning: n.  年龄,年老vt. vi.  成熟,变老
words.example: Do you know the age of that building?  你知道那座楼的历史有多久吗？

words.meaning: n.  政策，方针; 保险单
words.example: They believe that the European Community needs a common foreign and security policy.  他们认为欧洲共同体需要采取共同的外交和安全政策。

words.meaning: n.  程序,进行,过程vt.  加工,处理,对. . . 处置,对. . . 起诉a.  经加
words.example: Increasing the number of women in top management jobs will be a slow process.  增加高级管理职位女性的人数将是一个缓慢的过程。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  考虑,思考,认为
words.example: Don't make any decisions before you've considered the matter.  在仔细考虑过这个问题之前别作任何决定。

words.meaning: vi.  出现,显得,来到
words.example: He suddenly appeared in the doorway.  他突然出现在门口。

words.meaning: n.  人,人类a.  人类的,人性的,有同情心的
words.example: The human body is composed of about 60% water.  人体约60%由水组成。

words.meaning: n.  市场; 股市; v.  销售
words.example: Are you sure there's a market for the product?  你肯定这种产品有市场吗？

words.meaning: n.  兴趣; 利息; [常pl.  ]权益，利益
words.example: I've always had an interest in astronomy.  我一直对天文学感兴趣。

words.meaning: n.  结果,影响,效果,印象vt.  招致,引起,完成v.  效果
words.example: The radiation leak has had a disastrous effect on/upon the environment.  核辐射外泄给环境带来了灾难性的影响。

words.meaning: vt.  提议,建议,促成,使人想起,启发,暗示
words.example: They were wondering where to hold the office party and I suggested the Italian restaurant near the station.  他们在考虑在哪里开办公室聚会，我提议去车站附近的义大利餐馆。

words.meaning: n.  上升,高地,增高,提出vt.  升起,举起,唤起,提高,使出现,使复活,提出
words.example: Would all those in favour please raise their hands ?  赞成的人请举手好吗？

words.meaning: a.  从前的,前者的n.  形成者,模型,样板
words.example: The house, a former barn, has been attractively converted.  这座房子以前是谷仓，现已改建一新，十分漂亮。

words.meaning: n.  主修课,成年人,陆军少校a.  主要的,较多的,严重的,成年的vi.  主修
words.example: All of her major plays have been translated into English.  她的主要剧本都被译成了英文。

words.meaning: v.  需要; 要求; 规定
words.example: Please telephone this number if you require any further information.  如需更多资讯请拨此电话号码垂询。

words.meaning: n.  角色,职份,任务
words.example: What is his role in this project?  他在这个工程中负责甚么？

words.meaning: vt. vi.  决定,判决
words.example: They have to decide by next Friday.  他们必须在下周五前作出决定。

words.meaning: a.  军(事、用)的; n. [the ~]军队
words.example: The military has opposed any cuts in defence spending.  军方反对任何裁减国防开支的举措。

words.meaning: vt.  发展,发达,显影,洗印,进步vi.  发展,生长
words.example: It became clear that he wasn't developing like all the other little boys.  显然他没有像其他小男孩那样正常生长发育。

words.meaning: a.  联邦(制、政府)的
words.example: the federal government  联邦政府

words.meaning: n.  动作,作用,诉讼,行为,战斗控告
words.example: This problem calls for swift/prompt action from the government.  这个问题需要政府马上采取行动。

words.meaning: n.  季(节); 时期
words.example: How long does the dry/hurricane/monsoon season last?  旱／飓风／季风季要持续多久？

words.meaning: n.  导演; 主管; 负责人
words.example: She has become the director of the new information centre.  她成了新的资讯中心的主任。

words.meaning: n.  位置; 职位; 立场; v.  安置
words.example: Well, I've found our position on the map if you want to see where we are.  好啦，如果你想知道我们现在所在位置的话，我已经在地图上找到了。

words.meaning: a.  特殊的; 专门的; n.  特别节目
words.example: The car has a number of special safety features.  这辆汽车配备有一些特别的安全装置。

words.meaning: n.  空地; 空间; 太空; v.  隔开
words.example: Is there any space for my clothes in that cupboard?  那个衣橱还放得下我的衣服吗？

words.meaning: n.  位置,场所,地点vt.  定位
words.example: The council haven't yet chosen the site for the new hospital.  市政会尚未选定新医院的院址。

words.meaning: n.  方案，项目; v.  放映，规划
words.example: Her latest project is a film based on the life of a nineteenth-century music hall star.  她最近计划拍摄一部关于某位19世纪歌厅歌星一生的影片。

words.meaning: n.  活动; 活跃
words.example: There was a lot of activity in preparation for the Queen's visit.  大家都在为准备迎接女王来访而忙碌。

words.meaning: n.  法院,庭院,奉承vt.  献殷勤,追求,招致危险vi.  求爱
words.example: Protestors gathered outside the court to await the verdict.  抗议者聚集在法庭外等待判决。

words.meaning: n.  勤奋; 工业，行业
words.example: The city needs to attract more industry.  这个城市需要吸引更多的工业。

words.meaning: n.  盖子,封面,藉口vt.  覆盖,掩饰,包括,掩护,保护vi.  覆盖
words.example: The light was so bright that I had to cover my eyes.  灯光太亮，我只好遮住眼睛。

words.meaning: n.  陆地,地面,地界,土地,国土,地产vi.  登陆,登岸,到达vt.  使上岸,使
words.example: It is cheaper to drill for oil on land than at sea.  在陆地上钻探石油比在海上更经济。

words.meaning: v.  描写，描述; 称做
words.example: Could you describe your attacker?  你能描述一下袭击者的样子吗？

words.meaning: a.  个人的，私人的; 亲自的
words.example: My personal opinion/view is that the students should be doing more work outside the classroom.  我个人认为学生应该多做一些课外作业。

words.meaning: ad.  简单地; 简直; 只不过
words.example: You look simply (= really) beautiful in that dress.  你穿那条裙子看起来真漂亮。

words.meaning: ad.  几乎,密切地
words.example: It's been nearly three months since my last haircut.  从我上次理发到现在，已经快三个月了。

words.meaning: vt.  选择,宁愿,欲vi.  选择,喜欢
words.example: She had to choose between the two men in her life.  面对生命中的两个男人，她不得不从中作出选择。

words.meaning: n.  原因,目标vt.  引起,使产生,成为. . . 的原因
words.example: The police are still trying to establish the cause of the fire.  警方仍在努力调查失火的原因。

words.meaning: n.  证据,迹象
words.example: The police have found no evidence of a terrorist link with the murder.  警方没有发现任何证据证明这宗谋杀案和恐怖分子有关。

words.meaning: n.  文化，文明; 培养; vt.  培养
words.example: She's studying modern Japanese language and culture.  她在研究现代日本语言和文化。

words.meaning: vt.  了解,实现,使显得逼真,把. . . 变为现金vi.  变卖为现金
words.example: They didn't realize the danger they were in.  他们没有意识到自己身处危险之中。

words.meaning: a.  有用的,有空的
words.example: Is this dress available in a larger size?  这件衣服有更大一号的吗？

words.meaning: n.  机会,时机
words.example: Everyone will have an opportunity to comment.  每个人都有机会发表意见。

words.meaning: n.  情况,条件vt.  以. . . 为条件,决定,支配,使适应
words.example: Mum's still got our pram - it's very old, but it's in perfect condition.  妈妈还留着我们的婴儿车——虽然很旧了，但仍然完好。

words.meaning: n.  选择,精选品,选择权a.  精选的,挑三拣四的,可选的
words.example: If the product doesn't work, you are given the choice of a refund or a replacement.  如果产品不能使用，可选择退款或换货。

words.meaning: n.  行政,管理,中央政府
words.example: Teachers complain that more of their time is taken up with administration than with teaching.  教师抱怨他们花在行政工作上的时间超过了教学的时间。

words.meaning: n.  议会，国会; (代表)大会
words.example: Congress has rejected the recent presidential proposal on firearms.  国会否决了总统最近关于枪支的提案。

words.meaning: n.  竞选活动; vi.  竞选; 参加战斗
words.example: The protests were part of their campaign against the proposed building development in the area.  抗议是他们反对拟在该地区进行房地产开发的运动的一部分。

words.meaning: n.  材料; [常pl.  ]原料; a.  物质的，身体上的; 重要的
words.example: Crude oil is used as the raw (= basic) material for making plastics.  原油是制造塑胶的原料。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  经济(制度); 节俭，节约
words.example: Tourism contributes millions of pounds to the country's economy.  旅游业为这个国家带来数百万英镑的经济收入。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  结束,完结a.  靠近的,亲近的,亲密的,狭窄的秘密的,关闭的vt.  关,
words.example: Could you close the door/window please?  请关上门／窗，好吗？

words.meaning: n.  冒险,危险,保险额vt.  冒. . . 的危险,冒险干
words.example: In this business, the risks and the rewards are high.  这个行业的风险和回报都很高。

words.meaning: n.  涌流,趋势,流a.  流通的,现在的,最近的a.  当前的
words.example: Have you seen the current issue of (= the most recently published) Vogue magazine?  最新一期《时尚》杂志你看过了吗？

words.meaning: v.  牵涉; 包含; 使参与
words.example: The second accident involved two cars and a lorry.  第二次意外涉及两辆小汽车和一辆大卡车。

words.meaning: n.  防御，防卫
n.  木板,甲板,会议桌,海岸vt.  乘船,供膳食,用板铺vi.  搭伙n.  板
words.example: Cut the vegetables on a UK chopping / US cutting board.  在砧板上切菜。

words.meaning: n.  主题，对象; a.  (to)受…支配的; v.  (to)使服从
words.example: Our subject for discussion is homelessness.  我们讨论的话题是无家可归问题。

words.meaning: n.  行为,举止
n.  交易,协定,松木,买卖,份量vi.  处理,应付,做生意vt.  分配,发牌,给
words.example: The unions and management have made a two-year pay and productivity deal.  工会和管理层签订了一份为期两年的工资与生产效率协议。

words.meaning: vt.  代表; 表现; 描绘
words.example: They chose a famous barrister to represent them in court.  他们选了一位著名律师为他们出庭辩护。

words.meaning: n.  代理处; (政府等的)专门行政部门
words.example: She was freed from prison through the agency of her doctor.  在她的医生的推动下，她获释出狱。

words.meaning: ad.  最近
words.example: Have you seen any good films recently?  你最近看过甚么好电影吗？

words.meaning: vt.  减少,分解,降低,把. . . 归纳,把. . . 分解vi.  减少,变瘦,归纳为
words.example: Do nuclear weapons really reduce the risk of war?  核武器真的可以减小战争爆发的危险吗？

words.meaning: v.  似乎; a.  可靠的; 健康的; 合理的
words.example: They could hear the sound of a bell tolling in the distance.  他们能听到远处的钟声。

words.meaning: n.  罚款,罚金,晴天a.  好的,晴朗的,精细的,细小的,健康的vt.  罚款,精
words.example: The apartments are very small, which is fine for one person.  这些公寓很小，一个人住正合适。

words.meaning: n.  天生的白痴a.  自然的,自然界的,本能的,天然的,天生的,物质的,正常
words.example: People say that breast-feeding is better than bottle-feeding because it's more natural.  人们认为母乳喂养比用奶粉喂养好，因为母乳更为天然。

words.meaning: n.  系列，连续; 连续剧
words.example: There has been a series of sexual attacks on women in the area.  这个地区发生了一连串针对女性的性侵害案件。

words.meaning: a.  重要的,有含义的,非偶然的,有效的,暗示的
words.example: There has been a significant increase in the number of women students in recent years.  近年来，女学生的人数有了显著增加。

words.meaning: a.  (to)相似的，类似的
words.example: My father and I have similar views on politics.  我和父亲在政治上观点相似。

words.meaning: n.  回答; 反应，响应
words.example: Responses to our advertisement have been disappointing.  人们对我们的广告反应平淡，令人失望。

words.meaning: a.  死的,不活泼的,麻木的,熄灭的n.  死者ad.  完全地,突然地
words.example: She's been dead for twenty years now.  到现在她已经去世20年了。

words.meaning: n.  要素，因素; 【数】因数; 变量
words.example: People's voting habits are influenced by political, social and economic factors.  人们的选举习惯受政治、社会和经济因素的影响。

words.meaning: n.  十年
n.  文章,冠词,物品,条款
words.example: There was an interesting article on vegetarianism in the paper yesterday.  昨天报纸上登了一篇关于素食主义的有趣文章。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  救球vt.  解救,救,挽救,储蓄,保存,保留,保全,节省vi.  挽救,节省,
words.example: Wearing seat belts has saved many lives.  系安全带挽救了许多人的生命。

words.meaning: n.  库存; 股票; v.  储存
words.example: It is now halfway through winter and food stocks are already low.  现在冬天刚刚过半，但食物的储备已经不足。

words.meaning: n.  事业,生涯,速度
words.example: He's hoping for a career in the police force/ as a police officer.  他希望当一名员警。

words.meaning: n.  治疗,待遇,处置
words.example: Peter gets special treatment because he knows the boss.  彼得认识老板，所以受到特殊待遇。

words.meaning: vt. n.  接近; n.  方法，手段
words.example: We could just see the train approaching in the distance.  我们刚好能看到火车从远处驶来。

words.meaning: n.  基金,资金,贮藏,财源,存款vt.  提供资金,积累
words.example: The hospital has set up a special fund to buy new equipment.  医院专门设立了一项基金以购买新设备。

words.meaning: a.  严肃的,认真的,重要的,严重的
words.example: There were no reports of serious injuries.  没有接到有人重伤的报告。

words.meaning: vi.  发生，出现; 想到
words.example: An accident involving over ten vehicles has occurred in the east-bound lane.  在东向车道上发生了一起涉及十多辆汽车的交通事故。

words.meaning: n.  媒介，媒体
words.example: The issue has been much discussed in the media.  大众媒体对这件事讨论得很多。

words.meaning: a.  单独的; 独特的; n.  个人，个体
words.example: Every individual has rights which must never be taken away.  每个人都有一些不可剥夺的权利。

words.meaning: n.  品质,特质,才能,质量a.  优质的n.  品质
words.example: The food was of such poor/low quality.  这种食品的品质很差。

words.meaning: n.  压,榨,按,强制,压强,压迫,压力vt. 迫使,使增压,密封
words.example: He put too much pressure on the door handle and it snapped.  他用力过猛，把门的把手弄断了。

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]资源，财力
words.example: The country's greatest resource is the dedication of its workers.  这个国家最大的资源就是劳动者的奉献精神。

words.meaning: vt.  识别,认明,鉴定,使等同于vi.  一致,变成一致
words.example: Even the smallest baby can identify its mother by her voice.  就连年龄最小的婴儿也能根据声音分辨出自己的母亲。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  决定,决心
words.example: The number of staff we can take on will be determined by how much money we're allowed to spend.  我们雇用的人数将取决于可支配资金的多少。

words.meaning: a.  无限的,无边无际的
words.example: She has boundless energy and enthusiasm.  她有无穷的精力和无限的热情。

words.meaning: a.  可容忍的,可以的
words.example: At their best the conditions in these prisons are scarcely tolerable.  即使在最好的时候，这些监狱的条件也令人难以忍受。

words.meaning: a.  应服从的,会接纳的,肯服从的,有义务的

words.meaning: v.  分解; (使)腐烂

words.meaning: n.  格言,座右铭

words.meaning: a.  逐退的,可恶的,冷淡的,排斥的
words.example: What a repulsive old man!  这老头子真是令人厌恶！

words.meaning: n.  优势
words.example: The preponderance of evidence suggests that he's guilty.  大量的证据显示他有罪。

words.meaning: n.  欺骗,谎言

words.meaning: a.  亲切的,和蔼可亲的

words.meaning: n.  古话,格言,谚语

words.meaning: n.  圆周,周围,胸围

words.meaning: vt.  严责

words.meaning: n.  复旧,故态复萌,再发,恶化vi.  故态复萌,再陷邪道,再度堕落

words.meaning: a.  没有偏见的

words.meaning: n.  万能药

words.meaning: vt.  证明. . . 是不对的,提出. . . 的反证,反驳

words.meaning: n.  淤泥
words.example: The harbour silted up many years ago.  这座港口多年前就已淤塞了。

words.meaning: a.  有教养的,上流的,优雅的
words.example: The mansion had an atmosphere of genteel elegance and decay.  这座大宅透出上流社会的高贵典雅，也散发着衰败的气息。

words.meaning: n.  擦伤,气恼vt. vi.  摩擦,擦痛,激怒

words.meaning: a.  堕落的vi.  退化,堕落vt.  使变质,使退化

words.meaning: vt.  逗弄,使干着急

vt.  轻视,使渺小

words.meaning: vt.  压缩,束紧,使收缩vi.  压缩

words.meaning: a.  狂热的

words.meaning: a.  简洁的,简明的

words.meaning: n.  狗舍，狗窝

words.meaning: a.  不协调的,不一致的,前后不一的

words.meaning: a.  自负的,自任不凡的,夸耀的

words.meaning: vt.  抚慰,使和解,怀柔

words.meaning: vt.  用大字体书写,独占,使全神贯注

words.meaning: adv.  迄今，至今

words.meaning: v.  艰难行进

words.meaning: a.  不知羞耻的

words.meaning: n.  对流; 传送

words.meaning: a.  易怒的,难以取悦的,过敏的

words.meaning: n.  逗留,旅居vi.  逗留,旅居

words.meaning: a.  同性质的,适意的,趣味相同的

words.meaning: a.  巡回的n.  巡回者

words.meaning: a.  有事业心的，有进取心的

words.meaning: a.  和蔼可亲的,友善的,殷勤的

words.meaning: n.  仲裁人,公断者

words.meaning: n.  (砖、石灰等的)窑，炉

words.meaning: a.  可鄙的,卑劣的
words.example: He's a despicable human being!  他是个令人厌恶的人！

words.meaning: n.  气压计

words.meaning: a.  封建(制度)的

words.meaning: a.  无生命的; 无生气的

words.meaning: n.  子孙,后裔

words.meaning: n.  隔离,孤立,隐退
